messages:
mira: Quick sync — we need to lock the security OKRs for the next planning review. Main items: SOC2 readiness checklist, audit-log export pipeline, KMS/HSM launch criteria, and retention tiers.
kevin: I pushed a short draft to the roadmap doc earlier today. Key question: do we treat 7y retention as "must-have" for any enterprise deals or optional paid add-on?
samir: From sales chatter, a handful of regulated customers expect 7y, but most ask for 1–3y. 7y adds complexity (storage + e-discovery). Suggest we make it an enterprise-only opt-in feature.
mira: Agreed. For the OKRs I want a measurable goal: "SOC2 readiness audit started by EOY" and "audit-log export available to customers w/in 30 days of GA". Thoughts?
lex: For audit logs we need retention controls + tamper-evidence. Customers care about export formats (parquet vs json) and ability to ship to their S3. Also add a non-repudiation proof (hash chain) to meet some compliance asks.
kevin: Can we scope an MVP: export JSON logs to customer S3 with TTL policy and checksum metadata. Tamper-evidence can be v1.1 via signed digests. HSM-backed signing later.
security-bot: Note: SOC2 audit timeline estimate updated: 8–12 weeks prep + 2–3 week audit window if controls are in place.
mira: Good call. Prioritization props: high: SOC2 core controls + audit logs basic export; medium: HSM-backed signing + long-term retention workflows; low: built-in e-discovery UI.
samir: Customer-driven asks to surface: BankX requires KMS with HSM and key rotation logs; HealthCo needs 7y retention + redaction logs. Both are potential uplift to Dedicated/Private offering.
kevin: We should call out launch criteria for KMS/HSM: 1) FIPS 140-2/3 compliance statement, 2) key-rotation API, 3) audit trail of key ops, 4) non-exportable keys for HSM mode. If any missing, mark as "beta".
mira: Add risk mitigation: for GA we need regression checks for latency (no >20% p95 increase for hostings using external KMS) and cost model for long-retention buckets.
lex: Implementation note: prefer config-driven retention bands: {"retention_band": "standard|long|archival", "days": 365|1095|2555}. Example config:```json
{
  "retention_band": "long",
  "days": 2555,
  "export": {
    "enabled": true,
    "s3_destination": "s3://customer-audit-bucket",
    "format": "json"
  }
}
```
kevin: That helps productize. We also need a reversible approval flow for legal holds (preserve logs beyond TTL). Who owns that? ops or legal?
samir: Ops will implement the plumbing, legal will trigger holds. Need an API endpoint for legal to call.
mira: OKRs draft to propose: "SOC2: start pre-audit by 2026-06-30"; "Audit Logs: GA export to customer sinks by 2026-08-31"; "KMS/HSM: Beta with non-exportable keys + rotation by 2026-09-30".
kevin: Time estimates: audit logs MVP — 3 sprints; retention bands + storage cost analysis — 2 sprints; HSM b/w vendor integration — 4–6 sprints depending on vendor compatibility.
lex: Let's surface dependencies: infra (storage + lifecycle), eng-runtime (no latency regressions), devex (docs + SDKs), and security (policy + attestations).
mira: Action items: @kevin update roadmap doc with OKRs + launch criteria; @samir draft API spec for legal-hold; @lex prototype tamper-evidence digest flow. I'll collate and present at Friday planning. :eyes:
kevin: Will do. I'll flag enterprise customers who asked for 7y so growth can follow up.
samir: Drafting API now, will post a short spec by EOD.
lex: I'll sketch the digest and a small PoC for signed manifests.
mira: Cool — if we can get those artifacts by Thursday, we can finalize the Q3 OKRs. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
